Report as delivered in chat (plain text)

I found 51 new satellite postings this morning: 27 at Amazon Leo, 23 at Eutelsat and 1 at Telesat. Most of the Eutelsat ones are OneWeb Next and IRIS² engineering roles posted Oct 9–21. Yesterday's run missed them, so they're new to the tracker but not freshly posted. Since yesterday, 27 postings have closed: 23 at Amazon Leo, 3 at Telesat and 1 at Eutelsat. That leaves 1,110 open roles: 1,000 at Amazon Leo, 51 at Telesat and 59 at Eutelsat. The Amazon count stopping at exactly 1,000 is probably a cap on Amazon's search results, so the real number may be a bit higher. The full list of new postings is in the thread below, and the CSV of every open role is attached.
